name: release-0-5-0-decisions
body: v0.5.0 release-spec decisions. (1) Tree: version-command, changelog, license, brand-identity and new readme-presentation are contained by requirements.requirement.distribution (their feature=distribution). [autonomous] (2) Version output format: single line `kalide <version>` (e.g. `kalide v0.5.0`, `kalide dev`), for `version`, `--version` and `-v`. [with user — confirmed] (3) README: a sibling requirement readme-presentation rather than amending install-docs, because install-docs' AC is about install success and presentation/brand is a separate, separately testable concern; both realised by the existing solution.component.install-docs → README.md (body updated), so no new component. [autonomous] (4) Release-pipeline readiness: NO new spec node. The first-tag dry run is covered by the existing ACs of github-releases, native-ci-verification, package-manifest-update, homebrew-install, scoop-install, supported-platforms, tap-bucket-location, source-repo and install-docs; readiness is a plan-time verification against them (humans push the tag per global.constraint.humans-push-and-tag). [autonomous] (5) Domain: added domain.value.version and domain.value.brand-identity inside domain.group.distribution; values are realised through their group/entity (per solution.note.spine-values-and-tier4): release → cli-commands (version surface), changelog, license-notice; distribution group → brand-assets. [autonomous] (6) Solution: version folded into solution.component.cli-commands (already implemented-by internal/cli.Run). New components changelog and license-notice under release-pipeline; brand-assets under package-channels (docs/marketing surface), explicitly NOT under embedded-assets. Brand files live at repo-root `brand/`. [with user — confirmed] (7) implemented-by for CHANGELOG.md, LICENSE, NOTICE, TRADEMARKS.md and brand/* deliberately not authored: files do not exist; plan declares them as planned nodes. (8) Constraint: global constraints already forbid embedded logos and require an unbranded core, but frame it around templates/EY; a local requirements.constraint.brand-not-embedded on brand-identity makes kalide's own brand boundary explicit rather than editing the globals. [autonomous] (9) NOTICE chosen as the third-party notice file name. [autonomous] (10) SUPERSEDED by (13): recreating the mark as hand-authored SVG from a written description, the Inter wordmark and the PNG exports are all dropped. (11) Code vs brand licensing, following the standard open-source pattern (Mozilla/Rust/CNCF): code under Apache-2.0; the name "kalide" and the logo are reserved, rights holder Really Knows AI. Rationale: Apache-2.0 §6 already withholds trademark rights, but the logo artwork is copyrightable and would otherwise be read as covered by a repo-wide Apache LICENSE, so `brand/` is explicitly excluded (stated in NOTICE and a README license line) and carries its own `brand/LICENSE` (all rights reserved). A short repo-root `TRADEMARKS.md` permitted-use policy is included (refer by name and use the unmodified logo to link to the project; no use for forks/derived products, no modified logos, no implied endorsement). requirements.constraint.brand-not-embedded is extended to forbid Apache-licensing brand collateral or placing it outside `brand/`. Plan note: solution.component.homebrew-formula's `license` must be `"Apache-2.0"`. [with user] (12) Revised brand board: it contains only the mark, the wordmark, construction/typography notes, scalability sizes and the palette, so no process diagram is in scope for 0.5.0. [with user] (13) Supplied mark: the user supplied the logo SVG, so nothing is recreated. It is split into `brand/logo_dark.svg` (dark-filled tile, for dark backgrounds / dark mode) and `brand/logo_light.svg` (light-filled tile, for light backgrounds), keeping the path geometry unchanged, cropped to square viewBoxes and recoloured to the canonical board palette. The source, recipe and recolour map are in solution.note.brand-mark-source. The README may switch between the two via `<picture>`/`prefers-color-scheme`. [with user] (14) Wordmark: plain "kalide" text in lowercase Helvetica in docs, not an asset; no wordmark or lockup SVG, no outlined paths; Inter is not used. [with user] (15) No PNG exports for 0.5.0; the mark was designed to stay legible down to 16px. [with user] (16) The user revised the SVG source (orange facet reshaped into a five-sided facet; tile order swapped, light tile first). solution.note.brand-mark-source holds the current source. [with user]
